item.title: Operation QUICSILVER Targets Myanmar Government and IT with QUICAgent Backdoor
item.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a cyber espionage campaign targeting Myanmar that uses graduation ceremony invitation lures to deliver a Go backdoor called QUICAgent. The campaign, codenamed Operation QUICSILVER, has been found to target government and information technology sectors, per Seqrite Labs.
